findings.title: No CHANGELOG entry for a behaviour change
findings.claim: CONTRIBUTING.md:24 requires bugfixes and behaviour changes to be logged in CHANGELOG.md, and this PR changes behaviour (empty non-NULL payload now errors instead of decoding to zeros), but no CHANGELOG.md exists in the repo so the rule can't be followed as written; CONTRIBUTING.md:26 says to state that on the PR instead.

findings.title: Commit messages don't follow documented format/trailer convention
findings.claim: Both commit subjects are `fix(marshal): …` and neither includes the `Patch by …; reviewed by … for #####` trailer required by CONTRIBUTING.md:30-48, though recent commits on main ignore this rule too.

findings.title: Duplicated guard condition split across two adjacent blocks
findings.claim: marshal.go:995 and marshal.go:1004 both open `if info.Dimensions > 0 && data != nil {` back to back; they could be merged into one block running the bound check then the fast paths.

findings.title: Vector element-type classification duplicated across three functions
findings.claim: vectorElemMinSize (marshal.go:1125) adds its own elemType.(VectorType) check alongside vectorFixedElemSize and isVectorVariableLengthType (marshal.go:1181), meaning a new vector element type requires changes in all three places.

findings.title: Repeated struct literal across vector-type test helpers
findings.claim: makeVectorType repeats the struct literal already present in makeFloat32VectorType and makeDoubleVectorType; those two could instead be one-line wrappers around makeVectorType.

findings.title: Claim that helpers.go change alters metadata String() output everywhere
findings.claim: The standards sub-agent said the helpers.go:280-284 change alters metadata String() output everywhere, but this was checked and dropped: getCassandraLongType is only called from the vector parsers (frame.go:860, helpers.go:72, helpers.go:263), so only vector subtypes are affected.

findings.title: PR description overstates which new tests fail against pristine code
findings.claim: The PR description says "Every new test fails against pristine marshal.go/helpers.go", but TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads and TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType would pass against the old code since they check valid input, and TestVectorElemMinSize doesn't even compile against the old code; the description should say "every new rejection test" instead.
